Only tsconfig(5,5) baseUrl deprecation warning (TS5101) — pre-existing, unrelated to this change. Customer app has no node_modules installed so tsc not run there, but file parses cleanly on read.

critical_code_review_comments: Both files are consistent with the requested change: form is full-width (gap:14, width:100%) and all editable inputs + action buttons use borderRadius: 6. Row cards/badges/images intentionally untouched per spec.

Minor consistency nit (non-blocking): the two <TextInput> fields keep an inline height via array style but no explicit paddingVertical; inherited paddingHorizontal:12 from inputStyle is fine. Behavior unchanged.
Unrelated pre-existing: /app/frontend/tsconfig.json uses deprecated 'baseUrl' (TS5101). Not caused by this task; main agent can optionally silence with ignoreDeprecations.
